name: 50158 · Marshalltown, IA
findings: ZIP 50158 (Marshalltown) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50158 (Marshalltown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 50158 (Marshalltown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
